title: Test-run registration binds the claim-time work_revision, so any revise after claiming makes Engram refuse the run's verification record
outcome: A registered committed-input run binds the item's revision as it stands at registration (or refreshes the binding after a revise by the holder), so a run started after a revise earns its verification credit. A revise that happens after registration but before the record is written is still refused, as Engram's rule intends.
acceptance: The code path that fills binding.work_revision for a test-run registration is identified, and the claim-time source of the revision is confirmed.

Registration uses the item's current revision at registration time, or refreshes it after a revise by the holder. A regression test claims at revision N, revises to N+1, registers a run, and asserts that the binding carries N+1 and the verification record would be accepted, while a revise after registration still leads to refusal.
